page.layout: One page of text, right of the gutter; a narrow column of partly cut-off text at the left edge (the facing page, not to be transcribed as a margin note); below the text a short date line, a printed ornament.

main_text.p: rem & animi fcabitudi- nrm pofite,cum plurimo tuæ falutis voto, meafi placuerint,tuàqve faven- tia potiar, omnium mali. volentium hirritus & la- tratus facilè patiar.

page.notes: The text is partly printed with long s rendered as f-like "fcabitudi-" (read as scabitudi-, i.e. scabitudinem). Date line "clɔ Iɔc" is the reversed-C form for MD(C), read as printed: MDLXVIII. The bleed-through text from the reverse of the leaf and the cut-off left-hand column are not transcribed. Ornament below the text is not transcribed as text. Italic lines are set as printed; "Berloini" likely Berlodini or Berloini as printed, read cautiously.
